title: Coverage
text: This policy covers accidental damage to the insured vehicle, third-party liability, personal accident cover for the owner-driver, and damage caused by fire, theft, natural calamity, or riot. Coverage extends to the vehicle body, engine, electrical and mechanical parts, and factory-fitted accessories.

title: Exclusion -- Consequential Loss
text: Any consequential loss, depreciation, wear and tear, mechanical or electrical breakdown, failures, or breakages shall not be covered under this policy.

title: Exclusion -- Intoxication
text: Loss or damage arising while the vehicle is driven by a person under the influence of intoxicating liquor or drugs is excluded.

title: Exclusion -- Invalid Licence
text: Loss or damage arising while the vehicle is driven by a person who does not hold a valid and effective driving licence is excluded.

title: Exclusion -- Non-Disclosed Modifications
text: Damage to any non-factory-fitted accessory, modification, or alteration that was not disclosed to the insurer at the time of policy inception is excluded.

title: Deductible
text: A mandatory deductible of Rs 5,000 (Rupees Five Thousand only) shall be borne by the policyholder for each and every claim.

title: Coverage Limit
text: The maximum liability of the insurer under this policy shall not exceed Rs 3,00,000 (Rupees Three Lakh only) per claim, inclusive of all repair costs, parts, and labour charges.

title: Notification Period
text: The policyholder must notify the insurer of any incident giving rise to a claim within 7 (seven) calendar days of the date of incident. Failure to notify within this period may result in denial or reduction of the claim.
